description: Core implementation of Magnific Popup plugin, including module registration, event handling, and popup management functions.

classes.name: MagnificPopup
classes.description: Main class handling popup behavior, initialization, and control methods.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Magnific Popup plugin, detects environment, and sets up necessary variables.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a popup with specified options and content.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Helper method to perform cleanup and close actions.

methods.name: updateSize
methods.description: Recalculates and updates popup size based on window dimensions.

methods.name: updateItemHTML
methods.description: Updates the popup content based on current item.

methods.name: appendContent
methods.description: Sets and appends new content into the popup.

methods.name: parseEl
methods.description: Parses an element to create a popup item object.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Adds a group of elements to be handled as a popup group.

methods.name: _openClick
methods.description: Handles click events to open popup.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status message or indicator in the popup.

methods.name: _checkIfClose
methods.description: Determines if a click target should close the popup.

methods.name: _setFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to the popup or specified element.

methods.name: _onFocusIn
methods.description: Handles focusin events to trap focus within the popup.

methods.name: registerModule
methods.description: Registers a plugin module with specific options and methods.
